text: When a job runs N dev seats in parallel, hire N QA and N reviewer seats up front (count on qa/reviewer); one seat serialises QA-WRITE, QA-RUN and review across the parallel cards
evidence: JOB-20261006-0734: 2 backend seats, 1 QA + 1 reviewer; T-01 QA-RUN and T-02 review waited on busy seats until a second QA and reviewer were hired mid-job
